map.因为不同语言的字符可能长得几乎一样（如西里尔字母 а 与拉丁字母 a），攻击者可: Because characters from different scripts can look nearly identical (such as the Cyrillic а and the Latin a), an attacker can register a domain with the same appearance but different code points for phishing. That is why browsers apply display policies to IDNs: when multiple scripts are mixed, they often show the Punycode form instead of the original. Companies should register common variants of their brand domains.
